host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IBM host to emulate the 3287 printer for.

terminal_type.description: The TN3270 protocol version to use (tn3270, tn3270e, tn3270t).

lu_name_selection.description: Enable LU name selection as per RFC 1646.

no_auth.description: Skip authentication/login prompts if the host allows direct connection.

charset.description: Character set for the data stream (e.g., ascii, ebcdic).
